results.exactSource: Zones and sectors help you cut wasted labour. Zones run 0 to 5 by how often you visit. Zone 0 is the house. In this example, Zone 1 is near the house and holds what you pick often — herbs, salad greens. Zone 2 is the main garden and chicken run, visited once or twice a day. Zone 3 is the main field, visited weekly. Zone 4 is semi-wild — fruit trees and fodder needing occasional attention. Zone 5 is left wild.

Eka example leyi, Zone 1 yi le kusuhi na yindlu naswona yi na leswi u swi tshovelaka nkarhi na nkarhi — herbs na salad greens.
